query: Rank the five highest-risk rural Centre-Based Care services in Queensland.

answer.answer:
| Rank | Service | Approval no. | NQS rating | Approved places | Nearest public transport |
|---:|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | Napranum Early Childhood Centre | SE-40000427 | Working Towards NQS | 33 | 562.39 km |
| 2 | Northern Peninsula Area College - Bamaga Kindergarten | SE-40000624 | Working Towards NQS | 24 | 519.11 km |
| 3 | Tagai State College - Horn Island (Narupay Ngurpay Mudh) Kindergarten | SE-40000633 | Working Towards NQS | 20 | 482.08 km |
| 4 | Tagai State College - Moa Island (Kubin Ngurpay Lag) Kindergarten | SE-40000636 | Working Towards NQS | 12 | 445.52 km |
| 5 | Iama Migi Kaziw Mudh | SE-40000743 | Working Towards NQS | 14 | 445.52 km |

All five have the maximum v1 gap score of 3. There are 21 rural Queensland Centre-Based Care services in this triple-gap priority pool.

evidence.claim: The five listed services are the highest-ranked rural Queensland Centre-Based Care services under the v1 triple-gap screen, with service attributes and rank returned by the deterministic model.

methodology: Filtered to Queensland, rural, Centre-Based Care; used the highest-risk default of gap score ≥3.
Ranking order: gap score descending, nearest public transport distance descending, approved places ascending, then approval number ascending.
The national validated sample thresholds were transport P75 = 5.329 km and capacity P25 = 40 places.
limitations: This is a prioritisation screen, not evidence of a breach, non-compliance finding, safety outcome, or automatic enforcement trigger.
Approved places are authorised capacity; they do not establish demand, enrolment pressure, utilisation, or waitlists.

data.ranking_policy: gap_score DESC; nearest_public_transport_km DESC; number_of_approved_places ASC; service_approval_number ASC

thresholds.scope: National valid Centre-Based Care analysis sample with non-missing approved places
